messages:
anne: FYI we're locking acceptance criteria for the service release tomorrow. Need clear checks for SLA, docs, support, monitoring, pricing before we flip the switch.

raj: SLA proposals — 99.9% overall uptime, p95 latency < 180ms, p99 < 350ms for generation API. Define failure budget = 0.1% per month. Rollback on 3x error rate increase in 15m window.

miguel: Monitoring: add synthetic smoke test hitting /v1/generate every 1m from two regions, histogram for token latency, KV-cache hit metric. Suggested alert: "svc_gen_high_error_rate" when 5m error_rate > 1%.

elaine: Docs: publish release notes + step-by-step migration for customers pinned to old model versions, update pricing page with per-token delta if quantization/batching changes costs. Add in-console banner for first-week deprecation window.

caroline: Support readiness: create triage runbook, add escalation matrix to PagerDuty schedule, schedule 2x office hours next week with eng rotation. Also need canned replies for common issues (slow responses, auth errors).

deploy-bot: Deployment queued: release/v1.12 -> staging (ci-2026-03-20T09:00Z)

raj: Ops checklist: canary 5% for 6h, compare latency/cost vs baseline. If p99 increases >20% or cost per 1M tokens > baseline+15% -> halt rollout.

anne: Pricing: product proposes temporary beta pricing note and a cohort discount for Dedicated customers; finance signoff required. @maria-finance can you advise by EOD?

maria-finance: Ack'd, will review delta & margin impact, aim to reply by 18:00 PST.

miguel: Alerts -> I'll add Prometheus rules. Example rule:
```
alert: GenHighError
expr: increase(http_requests_total{job="generator",status=~"5.."}[5m]) > 50
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "High 5xx rate on generator"
```

elaine: Docs owner: @elaine will own migration guide; @henry will update API reference and SDK snippets.

anne: Ok actions:
- SLA + rollback criteria: @raj
- Monitoring + alerts + synthetic tests: @miguel
- Docs + in-console banner + release notes: @elaine, @henry
- Support runbook + PD schedule: @caroline
- Pricing delta + finance signoff: @maria-finance

Please update the shared google doc (link) with ETA for each item. Target: all checks done by EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

caroline: ack, will prep runbook draft by EOD today.

raj: I'll get canary plan up in ops-playbook and post back.

anne: Thanks team — I'll compile final acceptance checklist after you post updates. :rocket:
